claim_boundary: This is an outcome-free sensitivity analysis. It does not estimate a v2 model effect, choose the official sample target, set the practical Brier increment, set a decision rule, set an official seed, or authorize outcome review.
primary_estimand: Brier(active_control) minus Brier(full_automatic_evidence_model); positive values favor the full model.

statistical_model.description: A synthetic, bounded paired Brier-loss-difference process is evaluated on random canonical-pair subgraphs. The image_variance_fraction denotes the marginal variance fraction contributed jointly by the two image endpoints; two pairs sharing one image have induced correlation equal to half of this fraction.
statistical_model.success_rule: The normal-approximation lower endpoint of a two-sided 95% graph-aware interval exceeds the practical Brier increment. This is a sensitivity criterion, not the final v2 decision rule.

completion_and_workload_scenarios.rule: These are historical, nonbinding workload illustrations, not measured reviewer times, a budget commitment, or inputs to the accepted experimental design. The design assigns no expected review duration, adjudication rate, total-hour requirement, or collection window; actual values will be reported after execution.

feature_runtime_context.rule: Pilot local-match runtime is reported only as automatic-computation workload. It is not a monetary cost, a model effect, or a substitute for human review time.

prohibited_uses: Using v1 effect sizes or v1 model performance as a v2 true effect scenario
Treating descriptor directions as independent pairs
Treating the 400-pair mechanism sample as a deployment prevalence sample
Selecting the official target or seed from a favorable sensitivity row without the required pre-outcome decisions
Creating an outcome-review packet or calling v2_design_locked
